title: Collateral Administration Manual — Release of Units Pledged to Equipment & Vehicle Loans
content:
## Release provisions in force

1. **Loan status.** A unit pledged to an Equipment & Vehicle Loans loan may be released only while the loan is in active or paid-off status: on payoff every unit still pledged is released automatically, and while the loan is active a unit may be released on its sale or after its total loss.
2. **Release on sale.** A release on sale is registered as a collateral release request naming the unit's serial number and the net sale price, and is made only when at least one other unit remains pledged (the last unit is released only at payoff).
3. **Once per unit.** Each pledged unit may be released only once.
4. **Release proceeds.** The release price is applied to principal as release proceeds on the release date.
5. **Fees.** A partial release fee of the product's partial release fee amount applies to each release on sale; a total-loss release applies the insurance proceeds the same way but carries no release fee and no prepayment fee.
6. **Cross-collateral.** The test of the cross-collateral clause applies to every release except on payoff.
7. **Lien release.** The title lien is released, or the termination or fixture release is filed, within the product's lien release period in business days (Monday to Friday excluding Federal Reserve holidays) after the release.

## Release situations side by side

| Situation | Loan status | Registered as | Release fee | Cross-collateral test |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Payoff | paid off | released automatically, every unit still pledged | — | does not apply |
| Sale of a unit, another unit still pledged | active | collateral release request with serial number and net sale price | partial release fee | applies |
| Sale of the last unit pledged | active | not released on sale; released only at payoff | — | — |
| Total loss of a unit | active | release after total loss, insurance proceeds applied | none; no prepayment fee | applies |
| Any release | applied, deferred, nonaccrual or declined | not released | — | — |

## Whether a unit has already been released

The unit's pledge record and the release records pointing to it show whether it has been released; a pledge already carrying a release is not released again.

## Lien release period illustrated

Hypothetical: a release on a Wednesday, on a product with a 10-business-day period, with no Federal Reserve holiday in the following two weeks. Counting Monday to Friday only, the tenth business day after the release is the Wednesday two weeks later; a Federal Reserve holiday falling on a weekday inside that span is not counted, which moves the last day out by one business day.

## Clauses no longer in force

- "The release price is the greater of the net sale price and the product's partial release premium percentage of the unit's share of principal, that share being the principal balance times the unit's pledged value divided by the loan's pledged collateral value, rounded to cents" — no longer in force; superseded by the current basis.
- "after it the principal may not exceed the product's loan-to-value limit after release of the value still pledged, any excess being paid down at the same time" — no longer in force; superseded by the current basis.

The product figures named in these provisions — the partial release premium percentage, the partial release fee, the loan-to-value limit after release and the lien release period — remain those of the collateral desk schedule.
